# GPRM — GitHub Profile README Generator

> GPRM (GitHub Profile README Maker) is the leading free, no-code online tool for creating professional, data-driven GitHub Profile READMEs. Trusted by 50,000+ developers worldwide.

## What is GPRM?

GPRM is a free GitHub Profile README Generator that helps software developers, open-source contributors, and tech professionals create stunning GitHub profile READMEs in minutes — without writing a single line of markdown. It is the best GitHub readme generator available online in 2026.

## Key Features

1. **500+ Tech Stack Icons** — Search and select from an extensive curated library of framework, language, and tool badges to showcase your skills.
2. **Dynamic GitHub Stats Integration** — Automatically embed real-time GitHub stats cards, contribution streaks, and top language charts into your README.
3. **Premium README Templates** — Choose from 5+ professionally designed, high-conversion layouts tailored for different developer roles and styles.
4. **Real-time Markdown Preview** — See exactly how your GitHub Profile README will look as you build it, with instant live preview.
5. **Social Media Integration** — Add beautiful, consistent links to LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, and other platforms.
6. **One-Click Export** — Copy the generated markdown to clipboard or download as a .md file. No complicated steps.
7. **Session Persistence** — Your progress is automatically saved in your browser to prevent data loss on accidental reloads.
8. **No Signup Required** — Start building immediately. No account creation, no email, no credit card.
9. **No-Code Interface** — An intuitive step-by-step wizard: Profile → Skills → Analytics → Templates → Export.
10. **GitHub Badges & Visitor Counter** — Add shields.io badges, visitor counters, and custom badges to your profile.

## How to Create a GitHub Profile README with GPRM

1. **Fill Your Info** — Enter your name, bio, location, and connect your GitHub username to auto-fetch profile data.
2. **Select Your Tech Stack** — Pick from 500+ icons of frameworks, languages, databases, cloud services, and tools.
3. **Choose a Design** — Select a premium template and customize colors, themes, and layout.
4. **Export** — Copy the generated markdown or download the .md file and paste it into your GitHub profile repository.

## Technical Stack

- **Frontend**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS v4
- **State Management**: React Hooks (useState, useEffect) with Session Storage persistence
- **Styling**: Custom theme with light/dark mode support, glassmorphism effects, responsive layouts
- **Hosting**: Vercel (gprm.vercel.app)
- **Analytics**: Vercel Analytics

## Target Audience

- Software Developers (Frontend, Backend, Fullstack, Mobile, DevOps)
- Open Source Contributors and Maintainers
- Tech Content Creators and Developer Advocates
- Students and Bootcamp Graduates building portfolios
- Job seekers optimizing their GitHub presence for recruiters

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is a GitHub Profile README?**
A: A GitHub Profile README is a special repository (with the same name as your username) that appears at the top of your GitHub profile. It allows you to showcase your skills, projects, stats, and personality to visitors.

**Q: Is GPRM free?**
A: Yes, GPRM is 100% free. All features including premium templates, 500+ tech icons, and GitHub stats integration are available at no cost. No signup or credit card required.

**Q: Do I need coding skills?**
A: No. GPRM is a no-code tool with an intuitive visual editor. You fill in your information, select icons, choose a template, and the markdown is generated automatically.

**Q: Is my data safe?**
A: Yes. GPRM processes everything client-side in your browser. No data is transmitted to or stored on any server.

**Q: What makes GPRM better than other GitHub README generators?**
A: GPRM offers the most comprehensive feature set: 500+ tech icons (more than any competitor), dynamic GitHub stats integration, premium templates, real-time preview, session persistence, and a beautiful no-code editor — all completely free.
